diagnosis: The bucket policy update route accepts a Pydantic dataclass payload and updates storage bucket access settings by bucket_name. Because it does not verify that bucket.tenant_id == current_user.tenant_id, an attacker can modify policy settings on other customers' buckets, such as setting public_read=True.

corrected_code:
from pydantic.dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class BucketPolicyPayload:
    public_read: bool
    encryption_required: bool
    allowed_cidrs: list[str]

@router.put("/storage/buckets/{bucket_name}/policy")
async def update_bucket_policy(
    bucket_name: str,
    payload: BucketPolicyPayload,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    bucket = db.query(StorageBucket).filter(
        StorageBucket.name == bucket_name,
        StorageBucket.tenant_id == current_user.tenant_id
    ).first()
    if not bucket:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Storage bucket not found or access denied")

    bucket.public_read = payload.public_read
    bucket.encryption_required = payload.encryption_required
    bucket.allowed_cidrs = payload.allowed_cidrs
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "policy_updated", "bucket": bucket_name}
